cohort: 30 women with postpartum hemorrhage (bleeding ≥500 mL during labor or ≥1000 mL during cesarean delivery)
finding: A serum lactate threshold of 2.68 mmol/L was predictive of severe postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: The study examines serum lactate levels in women experiencing postpartum hemorrhage, some of whom underwent cesarean delivery, but the findings are not specific to mode of delivery.
